verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents reusable workflows (docs-25) and file-based skills like design.md and review.md (docs-13), but the strong version, review and rollback controls cover the code changes agents ship, not the automations themselves. Those controls include GitHub-backed branches and required reviews, a diff-first review, Review Hub, an audit trail, and a one-click rollback control. Versioning of automations is at best implied if skill files live in Git. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of workflows and skills, a review/approval flow for automation definitions, rollback of automation definitions, and hands-on corroboration.
